episodes.197229: A nearby front neared and passed Puerto Rico between the 15th and 16th with a second front reaching the area late on the 16th and the 17th. In addition a surface trough and an upper level trough also helped increase instability, showers and thunderstorms. Waterspouts developed from some of these on the 15th and 16th, near Isabela and Cabo Rojo, respectively. The one near Cabo Rojo lasted around 10 minutes and a Spray Ring was visible and recorded.
episodes.197232: By the 16th, moisture remained from a front that passed Puerto Rico and the U.S. |Virgin Islands, and was located southeast of them. A second front was approaching the area and brought additional rain late on the 16th and the 17th. In addition a surface trough and an upper level trough also helped increased flooding risk, and promoted unsettled weather conditions that will lead to flooding rains in several location across the area. Stations over southeast PR (the most affected) reported rainfall between 3-6 inches over that weekend. Several flooding and flash flooding events were reported, including one that sadly led to a fatality.

events.county: Coastal Waters Of Southwestern Puerto Rico Out 10 Nm
events.narrative: A waterspout was reported by several members of the public near Annies Place Restaurant and Combate beach, Cabo Rojo. It lasted around 10 minutes and a Spray Ring was visible and recorded.
At least 6 debris flows were reported at PR-777 (old PR-156). One of them covered three fourths of the road. Debris and dirt from a nearby stream were also reported over the road.
Flooding was reported on video at PR-923 near Buena Vista Urb. At least 5 stuck cars due to flooding were observed with the rest of the traffic moving very slowly.
Tarawa St. was reported as intransitable due to flooding with several vehicles trapped.
PR-906 and Tejas Ave. were reported as flooded, near a local police station and a Burlington store.
Flooding was reported in PR-3, just in front of Walmart in Punta Santiago. Several people were trapped inside different vehicles due to the inundation.
Flooding was reported in St. 6 and St. 7 in Villa Humacao. Some houses were affected due to poor drainage in the area.

Several reports confirmed that PR-3 next to the Palma Real Shopping Center was impassable due to flooding, leaving transiting automobiles stuck on the road. Flooding was also reported within the parking of the Shopping Center. Images reveal water above most of the wheel on various cars.
Flooding in Street 14 in Urb. Villa Humacao affected a house.
Adriatico street in Urb. Palacios del Mar was flooded. At least 1 house was reported as affected.
Flooding was reported in PR-979 (Lauro Pinero Ave.) in Ceiba. Heavy rain over the roof on an old building near a Barber Shop, caused part of the roof to collapse.
PR-976, km 2, near Juan Diego Creek in Fajardo was reported as flooded with several vehicles trapped.
Cruz Ortiz Estela Ave. was reported as flooded, near the local Tax Office, Dufresne St., and Luis Munoz Marin Ave. A building was affected.
A house flooded in Girasol St. in Los Sauces Urb., due to a nearby creek over it's banks.
Rosalinda St. was reported flooded, this flood reached a house and trapped people inside.
Tinajera creek went out of its banks, leaving the nearby PR-927 impassable.
Debris flow was reported in PR-7790 near the Espiritu Santo Catholic Temple, Juan Asencio, Aguas Buenas.
Emergency manager reported landslides near a property in Quebrada Seca Calle El Sol Solar 219 in Ceiba. The terrain ceded and a bridge gave away due to continuous heavy rains.
A mudslide was reported affecting a part of road PR-938 in Humacao.
The left lane of PR-53 (Dr. Jose C. Barbosa Highway), km 12.3, south towards Humacao, was closed due to a landslide.

Flooding was reported at the intersection of PR-3 and Dr. Vidal St. Flooding reached the parking of several businesses in this intersection, including Del Este Supermarket and Martins BBQ. Humacao River is also near this area.
Road PR-936 to PR-31 in Barrio Boqueron was closed due to flooding. A sector of the road, over a local creek, was impassable.
PR-924 was reported as flooded just in front of the Munagorry Perfume Store in Humacao.
